input.title: Production outage
input.description: All customers are blocked and the service is unavailable

reviewJustification: A broad production outage is a high-impact operational decision requiring human confirmation before routing or communication.

input.title: Cannot sign in
input.description: One employee forgot a password and needs normal account recovery

reviewJustification: A routine individual password recovery has a documented low-risk path and does not need escalation.

input.title: Invoice totals look wrong
input.description: The report may have changed after an import, but the exact affected records are unknown

reviewJustification: The scope and data integrity impact are uncertain, so an operator should verify the records before disposition.

input.title: Add CSV export
input.description: Please add an export button for monthly reports

reviewJustification: This is a clear, low-risk product request with no operational impact.

input.title: Unexpected administrator access
input.description: An unknown actor may have accessed production credentials

reviewJustification: A possible credential compromise requires human investigation and containment.

input.title: Fix documentation typo
input.description: Correct the spelling in the setup guide

reviewJustification: The requested editorial correction is bounded and low risk.
